business.title: Open a job position
business.goal: Create a position with the hiring requirements and capacity.

steps.title: Create the job position
steps.description: Record the title, department, description, and headcount for the new position.

outcome.statement: An active job position is available for candidate applications.
evidence: The job position shows its title, department, description, and requested headcount.
The job position is available in the hiring pipeline.

business.title: Register a candidate
business.goal: Record a candidate so they can be considered for positions.

steps.title: Register the candidate
steps.description: Record the candidate's name, email address, resume link, and source.

outcome.statement: The candidate is available to be added to a job application.
evidence: The candidate record shows the name, email address, resume link, and source.

business.title: Start and progress a candidate application
business.goal: Add a candidate to a position and manage the application through screening and interview.

steps.title: Find the job position
steps.description: Open the position the candidate is applying for.

steps.title: Find the candidate
steps.description: Open the candidate record to be considered.

steps.title: Create the application
steps.description: Associate the candidate with the job position and begin the application at screening.

steps.title: Move the application to interview
steps.description: Advance a screened candidate to the interview stage.

steps.title: Send for offer decision
steps.description: Hand the interviewed application to the hiring manager responsible for the position to decide whether to make an offer.

outcome.statement: The candidate application is in interview or awaiting the hiring manager's offer decision.
evidence: The application links the selected candidate and job position.
The application shows its current screening or interview stage, or is assigned for an offer decision.

business.title: Reject a candidate application
business.goal: End an application that will not continue and record why.

steps.title: Find the application
steps.description: Open the application that will not proceed.

steps.title: Reject the application
steps.description: Move the application to rejected and record the rejection reason.

outcome.statement: The application is rejected with a recorded reason.
evidence: The application shows the rejected stage.
The application displays a rejection reason.

business.title: Decide whether to make an offer
business.goal: Choose whether an interviewed candidate should receive an offer for the manager's position.

steps.title: Review the interviewed application
steps.description: Review the candidate and application for the job position.

steps.title: Decide on the offer
steps.description: Choose to move the application to offer or not to offer.

steps.title: Return the application to the recruiter
steps.description: Return the offer decision to the recruiter for follow-up, including rejection recording when no offer is approved.

outcome.statement: The hiring manager's offer decision is available for recruiter follow-up.
evidence: The application records the hiring manager's offer decision.
An approved offer application shows the offer stage, or a declined application is returned for rejection handling.

business.title: Decide whether to hire a candidate
business.goal: Choose whether a candidate with an offer should be hired for the position.

steps.title: Review the offer application
steps.description: Review the candidate's application at the offer stage.

steps.title: Review position capacity
steps.description: Review the position's requested and filled headcount before making the hiring decision.

steps.title: Decide on hiring
steps.description: Choose to mark the candidate as hired or not hired for the position.

steps.title: Return the hiring decision to the recruiter
steps.description: Return the hiring decision for follow-up, including rejection recording when the candidate is not hired.

outcome.statement: The hiring decision is recorded, and the position is closed when its headcount has been filled.
evidence: The application shows hired when the candidate is selected, or is returned for rejection handling when not selected.
A position whose filled headcount reaches its requested headcount shows as closed.
